# Botany As a botanist, it is your job to grow enough food to stop the chef from seeking "alternative sources". Grow lots of wheat, and when you get tired of that, grow weed. Breed plants that make chemicals for Medbay, the Bartender and Cargo, or just see how strange you can make them.
## Starting your shift Your locker has a portable seed extractor and a box of plant data disks. Find the hydroponics trays, the seed extractor, the biogenerator, the plant DNA manipulator and the seed splicer. Coordinate with the Chef to see if they want anything specific grown.
# Growing ## Hydroponics Tray
Fill the tray with water, add nutrients, and plant a seed. Every 10 seconds the plant grows a little, and the reagents in the tray change it: nutrients heal it and improve its stats, toxins hurt it, and weed and pest killers clear the tray. The tray uses up a little of its reagents every cycle.
- [color=red]Red light[/color]: the plant is dying or dead. Use a spade to dig it out. - [color=#0336ff]Blue light[/color]: it needs water. - [color=yellow]Yellow light[/color]: it needs nutrients. - [color=orange]Orange light[/color]: weeds, pests or toxins. Use a cultivator (mini hoe) on weeds. - [color=green]Green light[/color]: ready to harvest. Click it with an empty hand or a plant bag.
Perennial plants grow back after a harvest; the rest die. A harvest gives about one item for every 10 yield, and some of those come out as seeds.
## Seed Extractor
Use produce (or a bag of it) on the extractor to turn it into seeds. The seeds drop where you click. Seeds you put into the extractor by hand are stored, and you can take them out again from its screen.
## Biogenerator
Turns produce into biomass. Every unit of nutriment, vitamin and protein in a plant becomes biomass. Biomass buys nutrients, materials and lesser strange seeds. Put a plant bag in its output slot to catch what it prints.
# Genetics Every seed has [color=cyan]core genes[/color] (potency, yield, production speed, endurance, lifespan, weed growth and weed vulnerability), [color=cyan]chemical genes[/color] (what reagents its produce contains, as a percentage of its volume) and [color=cyan]trait genes[/color]. Use a plant analyzer to read them.
Potency multiplies how much of each chemical the produce holds. Traits like Densified Chemicals and the vesicle traits make produce hold far more.
## Plant DNA Manipulator
Extract a gene from a seed onto a plant data disk (this destroys the seed), then insert it into another seed. You can also remove chemical and trait genes, or replace a core gene with one from a disk. Immutable and Essential traits can't be removed. Extracted yield is capped at 10 and endurance and lifespan at 110.
## Seed Splicer
Splices two different seeds into a hybrid with averaged stats and both plants' chemicals. It can also infuse a seed with the reagents in a beaker: some reagents change its stats, and 100u or more of a reagent can become a new chemical gene. Infusing damages the seed; too much and it falls apart.
## Strange Seeds
Strange seeds have random stats, and may come with random chemicals and traits. Grow them, then extract the genes you want.
## Mutations When a plant's stats fall inside a species' mutation window, its seeds and produce can come out as a different plant. Watermelons with potency 30-50 and endurance 60-80 can become holymelons, for example.
## Grafting and Training Plant clippers take a graft from a plant, which carries one of its traits. Apply a graft to another planted tray to give it that trait. Some reagents slowly train traits into a growing plant.
## Chemicals Some chemicals have special effects on plants.
